user.title: Ecovacs GOAT
user.description:
Adds zone control for the mower: cutting height, mow mode, obstacle detection and mow direction per zone, plus starting individual zones.

Reuses the connection of the Ecovacs integration you already set up — no second login is created.

Only fill in the device field if your account has more than one Ecovacs device.

data_description.device_name: Part of the device name, e.g. "iHans". Leave empty to use the first device found.

abort.already_configured: The Ecovacs GOAT integration is already set up.
abort.ecovacs_not_configured: Set up the official Ecovacs integration with your Ecovacs account first.

data_description.extra_classes: Space or comma separated device classes to register in addition to the built-in list, for example another GOAT model reported as unsupported in your log.
